_about: The Bestiary's rebuilt creatures, written in the card Structure (book/cards/card-structure.md). The record: book/bestiary-design.md; each creature's own: book/cards/orc-warrior-redesign.md, grave-wisp-redesign.md, goblin-sneak-redesign.md, ogre-chieftain-redesign.md. Foundry reads these laid over ../bestiary.json (load.mjs FOUNDRY_OVERLAY): a rebuilt creature's old cards leave Foundry (they stay in ../bestiary.json as fixtures for the tests of the machinery they exercised). 'npc' names the creature the card belongs to; 'book': false: Chapter 14 writes the four creatures as stat blocks in its prose (drawing them as book cards is a later task). The numbers are the rank defaults' (bestiary-design.md, decisions 12 to 15 and the ranks); no number assumes a class.

cards.name: Hamstringing Axe
cards.flavor: The orc cuts low, at the leg that would carry you away.

foundry.automationNote: a Basic attack (the exploding die, its Critical row's 1d10!); Hindered (EoT) when a Tier 3 lands.

cards.name: Barbed Javelin
cards.flavor: The orc throws a short spear that stays in the wound.

foundry.automationNote: a Basic attack (the exploding die, its Critical row's 1d10!; it shares the At-will count with the axe); Lingering 1d4 (Bo/In) when a Tier 3 lands. The Setup's draw is text: an NPC's items are flavor.

cards.name: War Howl
cards.flavor: The orc throws its head back and howls, and the sound gets into your bones.

foundry.automationNote: the 2 Emanation around the orc, each enemy's Mind Save against its Power DC and its damage; Vulnerable 1 (EoT) on a Tier 1.

cards.name: Blood for Blood
cards.flavor: The wound only makes it angrier.

body.label: Trigger
body.text: The target deals Vigor damage to the orc (the blow that makes it Bloodied counts).

body.label: Effect
body.text: The orc Advances up to 2 toward the target, then makes a Basic attack against it with 1 Bane.

foundry.automationNote: offered by itself (the moment 'you take damage': Vigor damage, while Bloodied, the blow that Bloodies it counting; the triggering creature within 2 squares); Use: the Advance button, then the Basic attack with 1 Bane (the button takes the Basic attack that reaches the target; both reach: the GM picks).

sub: Advances up to 2 toward the target
makes a Basic attack against it with 1 Bane
makes a @Use[Basic Attack|banes:1|label:Basic attack (1 Bane)] against it

cards.name: Cornered
cards.flavor: Hurt, it stops fencing and starts throwing its weight around.

body.label: Passive
body.text: While the orc is Bloodied, its [[Shove]] gains 1 Boon.

foundry.automationNote: the roll dialog adds the Boon to the orc's Shove while it is Bloodied (a setting on the Feature: hooks, stateBoon).

cards.name: Shiv
cards.flavor: A short, ugly blade, and it knows where the armor ends.

foundry.automationNote: a Basic attack (its Critical row's 1d10!).

cards.name: Jeer
cards.flavor: It says something about your mother, in Goblin, and somehow you understand.

body.label: Tier 3
body.text: [R] 1d4 Ps; Taunted by the goblin (1 round).

foundry.automationNote: a Basic attack (it shares the At-will count with Shiv); Taunted by the goblin (1 round) when a Tier 3 lands (it ends when the goblin goes Down).

cards.name: Knife in the Back
cards.flavor: You were looking at the other one.

foundry.automationNote: its Requirement is checked against the target (flanking): the roll dialog warns when the goblin doesn't flank it.

cards.name: Shriek and Scatter
cards.flavor: One of them drops, and the rest remember how much they hate you.
cards.target: One ally with the Goblin Tag

body.label: Effect
body.text: The goblin can Evade 1, then uses Jeer.

foundry.automationNote: offered by itself when an ally with the Goblin Tag within 6 squares goes Down (a Minion pays it with an AP it kept: it has no Reaction Point); Use: the Evade 1 button, then Jeer (the button; the GM picks its target).

cards.name: Drifting
cards.flavor: Nothing in its way is quite solid to it.

body.label: Passive
body.text: The wisp's own movement can pass through creatures' spaces (it can't end in one), and a creature's space is never Difficult Terrain for it.

foundry.automationNote: the movement checks let the wisp's own movement through every creature's space (never ending in one) with no Difficult Terrain from creatures (a setting on the Feature: hooks, drift).

cards.name: Slipping Touch
cards.flavor: It reaches for you and is already somewhere else.

foundry.automationNote: a Basic attack of a Minor enemy; its Tier 1 is the Evade 1 button.

cards.name: Guttering Glance
cards.flavor: The light goes out behind your eyes.

foundry.automationNote: a Basic attack (it shares the At-will count with Slipping Touch); Half-Blinded (EoT) when a Tier 3 lands.

cards.name: Pass Through
cards.flavor: It drifts straight through you, and the cold stays.

body.label: Setup
body.text: The wisp Advances in a straight line; the targets are enemies whose space it passed through.

foundry.setup: The wisp @Move[advance|distance:speed]{Advances} in a straight line; the targets are enemies whose space it passed through.
foundry.automationNote: the Setup's Advance is a button (Drifting lets it through creatures); the straight line and the targets (up to two enemies whose space it passed) are the GM's: target them before the roll.

cards.name: Dying Flare
cards.flavor: It goes out the way a lamp does when it is dropped.

foundry.automationNote: offered by itself when the wisp would go Down (an Interrupt that saves nothing); the 1 Emanation around it, each creature's Instinct Save against its Power DC, the damage, Hindered (EoT) on a Tier 1; then the held damage lands and the wisp goes Down.

cards.name: Crushing Grip
cards.flavor: A hand closes round you like a door shutting.

body.label: Special
body.text: The ogre holds one creature at a time: a new Grab lets the first go.

foundry.automationNote: a Basic attack (the exploding die, its Critical row's 1d10!); Grabbed when a Tier 3 lands. By hand: one creature held at a time (the GM ends the first Grab when a second one lands).

cards.name: Roar
cards.flavor: It turns its whole face toward you and bellows.

foundry.automationNote: a Basic attack (it shares the At-will count with Crushing Grip); Staggered (EoT) when a Tier 3 lands.

cards.name: Great Sweep
cards.flavor: The club goes round at chest height.

foundry.automationNote: up to two targets, each its own roll and damage.

cards.name: Hurled Goblin
cards.flavor: The goblin has time to look surprised.

body.label: Requirement
body.text: A willing Minion ally is within the ogre's Reach.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The ogre places the Minion in an empty square adjacent to the target (hit or miss); it takes no damage and triggers no Reactions.

foundry.automationNote: the attack runs by itself. By hand: the Requirement (a willing Minion ally within its Reach) and the landing: the GM moves the Minion to an empty square adjacent to the target (Alt-drag).

cards.name: Crack the Ground
cards.flavor: It brings the club down two-handed, and the floor gives.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The squares of the Line are Difficult Terrain for every creature (EoE).

foundry.automationNote: the Line 3 from the ogre's space, each creature's Instinct Save against its Weapon DC and its damage; the Line stays on the map as a Zone that is Difficult Terrain for every creature, the ogre too, until the encounter ends.

cards.name: Backhand
cards.flavor: You stepped inside its reach as if it weren't looking.

body.label: Trigger
body.text: An enemy enters a square adjacent to the ogre.

body.label: Effect
body.text: It takes [V] 1 Bl and is Pushed 2, with no roll. Its movement isn't disrupted: it goes on with the movement it has left.

foundry.automationNote: offered by itself when an enemy enters a square adjacent to the ogre (a Trigger: the mover isn't moved back and goes on with the movement it has left); Use: the 1 Blunt damage button and the Pushed 2 button.
